value:
set -euo pipefail
STUDY=/data/users/ali/sgw-01/source/c2aac12
ROBOLAB=/data/users/ali/vla_wam/external/RoboLab-pi05-v3-0aef241
PY=/data/users/ali/vla_wam/envs/robolab-v2-isaac50/bin/python
OUT=/data/users/ali/sgw-01/preflight/rtx-20260922b
test ! -e "$OUT/renderer.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT" "$HOME/.cache"
exec > >(tee "$OUT/renderer.log") 2>&1
test "$(git -C "$STUDY" rev-parse HEAD)" = c2aac12b5923e45d11197e4dd96309327bfb80b3
test -z "$(git -C "$STUDY" status --porcelain)"
test "$(git -C "$ROBOLAB" rev-parse HEAD)" = 0aef241fb088ca21bb4ebd24448940ed56620d17
test -z "$(git -C "$ROBOLAB" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
cd "$STUDY"
"$PY" tools/validate_vla_wam_v3_protocol.py --quiet
"$PY" tools/validate_vla_wam_v2_protocol.py > "$OUT/v2_validation.json"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,uuid,driver_version,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader | tee "$OUT/gpu_identity.csv"
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name --format=csv,noheader > "$OUT/gpu_processes_before.csv"
test ! -s "$OUT/gpu_processes_before.csv"
used=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits)
if ! [ "$used" -le 1024 ]; then
  echo 'BLOCKED: allocated GPU has more than 1024 MiB already occupied; no simulator or model imported.' >&2
  exit 46
fi
test -r "$VK_ICD_FILENAMES"
export PYTHONPATH="$STUDY:$ROBOLAB"
"$PY" -m experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.build_asset_manifest --robolab-root "$ROBOLAB" --output "$OUT/assets.json"
cd "$ROBOLAB"
exec "$PY" -m experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.runtime_preflight --study-root "$STUDY" --robolab-root "$ROBOLAB" --assets-manifest "$OUT/assets.json" --output "$OUT/renderer.json" --headless --num-envs 1 --device cuda:0 --renderer realtime --rendering-type balanced
